title: Startup, shutdown & crashes
blurb: Won't turn on, slow to start, blue screens, restarts by itself, won't shut down.

remedies.title: Start in Safe Mode
remedies.why: Safe Mode starts with the minimum of drivers and apps, to fix a problem that stops normal startup.

steps.text: Settings › System › Recovery › Advanced startup › Restart now › Troubleshoot › Advanced options › Startup Settings › Restart › press 4.
From the sign-in screen: hold Shift and click Restart.
Apple silicon: shut down, hold the power button until Options, pick the disk, hold Shift › Continue in Safe Mode. Intel: hold Shift at startup.
Restart normally to leave Safe Mode.

remedies.title: Stuck on the Windows logo or spinning dots
remedies.why: An update is finishing, a driver hangs, or startup files are damaged.

steps.text: Wait 30 minutes if an update just installed.
Unplug all USB devices and docks; restart.
Turn it off with the power button three times during startup to reach Recovery › Startup Repair.
Then Safe Mode, or Uninstall Updates, or System Restore.

remedies.title: Find out why my computer or an app crashed
remedies.why: The system keeps a history of crashes with the app or driver involved.

steps.text: Reliability Monitor: red X's per day, click for details.
Event Viewer › Windows Logs › System for detailed errors around the time.
Console › Crash Reports and Log Reports.
Export DeskMedic's report to share with IT.

remedies.title: Computer is noisy or slow for a while after starting
remedies.why: Updates, sync, antivirus and indexing all run right after you sign in.

steps.text: Give it 5–10 minutes after starting; it settles down.
Turn off startup apps you don't need.
Turn off login items you don't need.
Restart rather than shutting down for weeks; long uptime makes the catch-up worse.

remedies.title: Computer beeps or flashes lights and won't start
remedies.why: Beeps and light patterns are hardware error codes (often memory, graphics or battery).

steps.text: Count the beeps or flashes and look the pattern up for your model on the maker's support site.
Unplug everything, hold power 30 seconds, plug in only the charger and try again.

remedies.escalate: Beep codes usually mean hardware; tell IT the pattern and the model.
